name: Google Consent Mode v2 (bridges Complianz consent to gtag)
desc: Default-denies ad/analytics storage before any Google tag loads, then updates via gtag consent update when Complianz reports a category change - same cmplz_fire_categories/cmplz_revoke events already used by the existing Clarity consent bridge on this site. Lets GA4/Google Ads model conversions using the consent signal (site has no Complianz Premium, this is the free/manual wiring).
